en: A black-and-white photograph of a broad, European-style street lined with stone buildings that feature arched arcades and ornate facades. Some signs on the buildings are visible, written in what appears to be German. There are pedestrians and a few early 20th-century vehicles, adding to the street scene's bustling atmosphere. The image has a vintage and possibly pre-war look.
